summary.title: Summary
paragraphs: I am an SDET / QA Automation Engineer working across web, mobile, and API testing. My toolkit includes Java, Selenium, TestNG, Appium, and REST Assured.

I focus on maintainable automation, reliable regression coverage, and useful failure diagnostics. I collaborate with developers and product teams to translate requirements into practical test strategies.
My background in research and data science also informs how I approach data validation, investigation, and problem solving.

description: Working on the Vendor platform across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and backend systems.
Collaborating with Ads, Vendor, Finance, and Data Science teams on monetisation features, billing, reporting, and partner payouts.
highlights: Validate campaign creation, ad serving, billing, and reporting workflows.
Design coverage across Selenium, Appium, TestNG, REST Assured, and GraphQL.

description: Quality engineering and automation for web and mobile applications.
highlights: Build and maintain automation frameworks using Java, Selenium, Appium, and TestNG.
Develop data-driven UI and API tests.
Support cross-browser and cross-device validation with Dockerized Selenium Grid.

description: Supported analytical workflows through data preparation, validation, and model evaluation.
highlights: Assist with data collection, cleaning, and preprocessing.
Support exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Validate data consistency across sources and API-driven workflows.

description: Practical training in test automation, framework design, and end-to-end web application testing.
highlights: Build automation using Selenium, TestNG, Page Object Model, and Gradle.
Translate application workflows into test scenarios.
Create reusable test components and review automation code.
